Screens & details

Dates & sources

January 2013 is the date recorded in the existing portfolio.

I made Webstiles when I started working with clients. I needed a way to show them colors, type and interface elements before spending time on the full website.

I’d make a Webstile, send it over, and work through their feedback. It became part of my usual workflow. The responsive template runs on Sympl.
